question: What did Abram do when he heard that Lot had been captured?
options: He prayed and waited for the kings to return Lot
He paid a ransom for Lot
He led his trained men to rescue Lot and recover the goods
He asked the king of Sodom for help
explanation: Abram called out his 318 trained men, pursued the kings, defeated them, and brought back Lot and all the goods.
